description: Defines the Budget class representing a monthly spending target, including serialization methods and a copyWith method.

classes.name: Budget
classes.description: Represents a monthly spending target with fields for id, category, limit, spent, month, and year. Includes methods for JSON serialization/deserialization and copying.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Creates a new Budget instance, optionally replacing the 'spent' value.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the Budget instance into a JSON-compatible map.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a Budget instance from a JSON map.

methods.name: encodeList
methods.description: Encodes a list of Budget instances into a JSON string.

methods.name: decodeList
methods.description: Decodes a JSON string into a list of Budget instances.
